summary.text: Dean Cascadden is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Belknap 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
He is an educator and administrator who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said his priorities are public education, environmental stewardship and property tax relief.

paragraphs.text: Dean Cascadden graduated from Littleton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College in 1983, a graduate degree from Regent University in 1993 and a Ph.D. from The College of William and Mary in 1996.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a biology teacher, a middle school principal, a district curriculum director and a superintendent of schools.
He also said he is president of the Lake Wicwas association and its lake host coordinator.
Cascadden advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary for Belknap 2, a two-seat district, along with Seth Wheeler.
In the survey, he listed supporting public education, environmental stewardship and property tax relief as the key messages of his campaign.
